Point Reyes 的尺度比一张灯塔照片大得多。第一次来，可以把半天交给 B: Point Reyes is much larger than its familiar lighthouse photograph suggests. For a first visit, spend half a day at Bear Valley: learn about the peninsula at the visitor center, take a short geology walk, then choose a comfortable turnaround point in the woods. All three parts share one starting area, leaving time for children to move from exhibits to leaves and for adults to sit down.
先选短线，把车程留在预算里: Choose a short walk and allow for the drive
编辑建议：普通短线留 2–3 小时，不含湾区往返车程；若走到 Divide Me: Editorial timing: allow 2–3 hours for the short outing, excluding the drive from elsewhere in the Bay Area. For Divide Meadow, allow 3–4 hours in the park and adjust to the slowest person in your group.
NPS 当前说明普通日间入园、步行和游客中心及步道口停车免费；餐饮、往返交通、露: NPS currently lists ordinary day entry, walking and parking at visitor centers and trailheads as free. Food, transportation, camping and special activities are separate.
导航直接设 Bear Valley Visitor Center，先保存离线地图: Navigate directly to Bear Valley Visitor Center and save an offline map and return route. A broad search for Point Reyes may lead somewhere other than this outing’s starting point.
带水、简便午餐、能防风的外层和好走的鞋。树林与海岸天气可能不同，不凭出发地的气温: Bring water, a simple lunch, a wind-resistant layer and comfortable walking shoes. Woodland and coastal weather can differ; do not dress solely for the temperature at home.

以下停留时间为编辑建议，地图用于定位。只沿当天开放、现场允许的路径行走，体力不足: The following times are editorial suggestions, and map links locate each stop. Use only routes open and permitted on the day; finish after any stage if needed.
建议留 25–40 分钟，看生态与历史展陈，并向工作人员确认当天路况。先用洗手间: Allow about 25–40 minutes for ecological and historical exhibits and to ask staff about trail conditions. Use the restroom and note your parking location. If the building is closed, use outdoor orientation information and start a short walk instead of chasing another opening time.
从游客中心停车区走向野餐区旁的步道口。官方列环线约 0.6 英里；可用 30–4: Walk from the visitor center parking area to the trailhead beside the picnic area. The official loop is about 0.6 mile; allow 30–45 minutes for the San Andreas Fault signs and invite children to spot the offset shown by the demonstration fence. Reading the landscape rewards a slower pace.
第三站 · Bear Valley Trail 林荫段: Stop 3 · The wooded section of Bear Valley Trail
回到 Bear Valley Trailhead，再沿宽阔土路进入树林，事先约定: Return to Bear Valley Trailhead and enter the woods on the broad dirt trail. For a light version, agree to turn around after 20–30 minutes. If everyone wants more, the roughly 3.2-mile round trip to Divide Meadow is an optional extension. Rest there and retrace your steps to the parking area; reaching the coast is a separate undertaking.
按路面、孩子体力与天色收尾: Finish according to the surface, children’s energy and daylight
Earthquake Trail 虽然铺了沥青，NPS 明确提醒部分路面下陷或倾: Although Earthquake Trail is paved, NPS warns of sunken or sloping sections that do not currently meet full accessibility standards; some wheelchair users may need assistance. The packed-dirt route to Divide Meadow includes slopes exceeding 5% and rocky patches, and the meadow toilets are not accessible. For small-wheeled strollers, manual wheelchairs or anyone concerned about uneven ground, ask the visitor center about current conditions and treat the exhibits and nearby usable areas as a complete shorter visit.
给当天留一个明确的终点: Give the day a clear finishing point
孩子开始累、雨后路滑或雾让驾驶变慢时，就回 Bear Valley。建议在仍有充: Return to Bear Valley if children tire, paths are slippery after rain or fog slows the drive. Finish walking with plenty of daylight left, have a snack and check offline navigation before setting off. The lighthouse and distant beaches need additional driving and time, so they make a more relaxed separate outing.
